note: E2B is the product brand of FoundryLabs, Inc., founded 2023, San Francisco. Raised a $21M Series A (July 2025) led by Insight Partners, bringing total funding to $32M per the company's own announcement; earlier round(s) totaling ~$11M were not individually detailed in sources reviewed. A 2024 HN hiring post by CEO Vasek Mlejnsky mentioned 'just closed a new round of funding' with a team of 4, consistent with an earlier seed round predating the Series A. No YC or other accelerator affiliation confirmed.
